utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina, you mentioned the repair drive. Can you tell me more about what's needed?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you checked if the repair drive is compatible with our version?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Compatible with our version? I'm not sure—could you clarify what version you mean? Is this for the event next weekend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, I'm helping with the repair drive this Saturday. Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, thanks! I'm bringing my old toaster. Do you know what time we're starting exactly?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think we're starting at 9 AM. I'll be there early to set up if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Kira! So we're having a neighborhood repair drive next Saturday—bring broken stuff and we fix it together. I still don't know the exact start time though, maybe 9 or 10.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that? I've seen repair drives before where they just scratch the surface.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I hear you, but it's still a good idea to bring your broken stuff and we'll give it a try together. I'm hoping we'll get the exact time soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye, you heard about the repair drive next Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, actually it's been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, great to know! Thanks for the heads up, I'll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Cleo, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at 9? We're meeting in the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Actually, Opal, I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, I didn't know it was moved. Are you sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Sorry, I think I missed the memo again.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Noah, we're fixing up the community center this Saturday! Starts at 9 AM, and we could really use your help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Saturday at 9? I'll try to remember that—I've got it written down somewhere... probably.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'd like to go, but I need a definite start time. Have you heard when it starts exactly?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's at 10 am Saturday. I'll be there with my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, 10 am works for me. I'll bring my old blender.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia! Did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing old appliances for free!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds great, but I'm a bit worried about whether it'll work with our older system. Did they mention compatibility?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I'm not sure about that, but I can ask Quinn—he's organizing it. Want me to check?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I just heard it's definitely 9 AM Saturday at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No problem, see you there!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: So, are you in for this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'd like to help, but do we know what time it starts on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We're starting at 9 AM sharp. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, any news on when that repair drive is heading out?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Ira! It's this Saturday at 9 AM in the community center parking lot. I'm still trying to round up volunteers, though.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, this Saturday? Good to know. Need any help with the equipment?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Gus! Just a quick update—the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, Sunday works for me too. I'll bring my toolbox as planned.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Gus! Glad it still works for you. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It starts at 10 AM. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Wait, I thought you said 9 AM earlier? Did the time change?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No, it's always been 10 AM. Sorry for any confusion!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, I keep hearing about this repair drive. Is it this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, it's this Saturday, but I'm not sure if it's 9 or 10. We should double-check.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good idea, I think I heard 9 from Opal, but let's confirm.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What's a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, it's a neighborhood event where we bring broken things to fix together. I think I have a blender to bring... or was that last month?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've never been to one. Is it this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, just let me know what you're working on. I've got wrenches, screwdrivers, even a multimeter if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate that, Gus. I just... I'm not sure I'm ready to get into it yet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush, Uli. Whenever you're ready, I'm here.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just really nervous we'll start the repair and realize it's the wrong fit.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I understand your worry, Pia, but I really just need to know what time it starts so I can plan my day.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It's supposed to start at 2 PM, but I'm still worried it won't fit our system.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring your broken stuff to the community center Saturday at 10. We'll fix it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, Leo, the repair drive starts at 9 AM, not 10. Don't want anyone showing up late!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks Opal, I'll update the time. 9 AM it is.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Vik, yeah I'm planning to go, but I still need to find some volunteers to help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can help round up some folks! Let me make a few calls and see who's free on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That would be great, Quinn! Thanks for offering to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Ira, just a heads up—the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, Sunday? Got it. Need any help with the equipment?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, that'd be great! I'm still taking inventory, so any help sorting tools would be awesome.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you check the compatibility yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not yet, but I'll look into it. Do you know who has the list of broken items?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No idea, maybe check the community board or ask Pia.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Hana, are you able to help with the repair drive this weekend? We're in need of some basic tools like hammers and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, I thought the repair drive was next weekend, not this one. Are you sure about the date?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'm sure—it's this weekend. The flyer says Saturday and Sunday. Can you make it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Tess, did someone say repair drive? I keep feeling like I'm out of the loop.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh hey Noah! Yeah, there's a community repair drive this weekend—they're fixing old appliances for free. I heard it's starting at 10 AM on Saturday, but I'm waiting to hear back from Quinn to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Saturday? I thought that was next month. Good thing you told me—I'd have missed it for sure.
